scope: Four isotropic kernels and empirical semivariance plus supplied-covariance GLS/universal kriging; partial spatial mixed-model support only
integration_status: Public execute/formal tests,production exported C ABI fixtures and matching native SQL PASS;bounded partial contracts only

common_contract.input: Finite nonempty rectangular data,abs<=1e100,at most1M cells; caller handles missing observations and coordinate units. Different methods have explicit row/dimension caps. All supplied parameter entries finite,<=16384.
common_contract.kernels: kind0 spherical(max(1-d/rho,0)^2*(1+d/(2rho)) for d<rho),1 exp(-d/rho),2 exp(-(d/rho)^2),3 rho^d. Euclidean isotropy in1..3 coordinates; partial sill1e-100..1e100,nugget0..1e100,rho>0<=1e100 and power rho<1. Four19.2 equation images individually inspected. Nugget is an absolute variance, unlike JMP displayed nugget/residual scaling.
common_contract.measurement_errors: Nugget belongs to an observation record,not merely a coordinate. Distinct collocated records covariance=partial sill; diagonal=partial sill+nugget. Pair semivariance0 on self diagonal and nugget at distinct collocated observations. Saved prediction targets an independent new measurement at query coordinates; latent cross covariance never includes query nugget.
common_contract.GLS: Fixed supplied absolute covariance only,not estimated from y. Exact fixed-response fits have finite likelihood under known V; no fictitious residual-variance estimate. Returned coefficient covariance includes intercept and known covariance only. Numerically singular covariance/design rejects at relative Cholesky diagonal1e-12; cov constructor may returnPSD/singular matrices with positive_definite_at_tolerance=false.
common_contract.prediction: Universal-kriging variance includes estimation of the fixed trend with covariance known; no covariance-parameter estimation uncertainty. Tiny relative-negative rounding at1e-9 of contributing terms clamps to0; material negative variance rejects. Saved triangular factors and positive G inverse are syntax/PD validated,not cryptographically authenticated or reconstructed to prove consistency.
common_contract.saved_model: [1,n,d,p,kind,sill,nugget,rho,feature_origins(p),feature_mean_offsets_scaled(p),feature_difference_scales(p),bstd(p+1),training_coords(n*d rowmajor),normalized_design(n*(p+1) rowmajor),R_inverse_residual_original_y_units(n),lower_Cholesky_R(n(n+1)/2 rowmajor),lower_symmetric_inverse_Gram((p+1)(p+2)/2 rowmajor)]. R=V/(sill+nugget),bstd is coefficient vector in original response units against normalized centered features. Length8+3p+(p+1)+n*(d+p+2)+n(n+1)/2+(p+1)(p+2)/2,<=10580.
common_contract.variogram: No response-trend removal,robust/Cressie estimator,minimum-pair threshold,spatial weights or variogram fitting. Default distance range uses observed minimum/maximum; exact collocated distances included; empty bins use JSON null. Width boundaries are the specified equal-width contract,not a claim to duplicate every JMP automatic bin adjustment.
common_contract.limits: Kernel parameters and GLS coefficients must have finite physical binary64 outputs; otherwise return error/SQL NULL with rescaling guidance. No installed-JMP or cross-platform numerical validation.
common_contract.numerical_repairs: Direct semivariance uses expm1/analytic correlation complements and physical small-distance products,retaining nugget and representable tiny process increments even when covariance entries round equal. GLS coefficient covariance applies sqrt(total_sill) to transformation factors before quadratic products. Material-negative predictive variance uses a normalized finite comparison,never an overflowing absolute tolerance sum. Zero-nugget queries exactly matching a training coordinate and normalized trend row have structural zero latent/observation variance after material-negative validation.

operations.description: Four isotropic JMP spatial kernels: locations in1..3 dimensions; [kind0spherical/1exponential/2Gaussian/3power,partial_sill,nugget,rho]. Independent record nugget; covariance and semivariance matrices.
operations.estimator: Direct four published correlation functions; nugget added only on diagonal observation records
unsupported: Covariance range/sill/nugget ML/REML or variogram-NLS estimation
Anisotropic/directional parameter fitting and random-effects G-side combinations
Covariance-parameter uncertainty,spatial F/df corrections and automated model selection

operations.description: Empirical isotropic Matheron semivariogram: rows[coordinates1..3,response]; [bins=10,lower=min_pair_distance,upper=max_pair_distance]. Pair counts,mean distance and half mean squared differences; empty classes null.
operations.args: 0..3 values: bins1..100=10,lower>=0=minimum observed distance,upper>=lower=maximum observed distance
operations.estimator: All unordered i<j pairs in inclusive bounds; equal-width classes left-closed/right-open except final inclusive right edge; identical bounds collapse to one bin
unsupported: Covariance range/sill/nugget ML/REML or variogram-NLS estimation
Anisotropic/directional parameter fitting and random-effects G-side combinations

operations.description: Gaussian GLS with supplied absolute isotropic spatial covariance; rows[coordinates,fixed features,response]; [dimensions1..3,features0..12,kind,sill,nugget,rho]. Fixed effects,covariance,likelihood and reusable universal-kriging parameters; no covariance estimation.
operations.args: Exactly[d,p,kind,sill,nugget,rho]; covariance parameters physically supplied and fixed
operations.estimator: Cholesky normalized by total sill; origin/difference-scaled feature and response GLS; standardized whitened Gram Cholesky(relative diagonal tolerance1e-12); known absolute V, no residual-scale fit
unsupported: Covariance range/sill/nugget ML/REML or variogram-NLS estimation

Covariance-parameter uncertainty,spatial F/df corrections and automated model selection

operations.description: Saved spatial GLS universal-kriging prediction: rows[coordinates,fixed features]; unchanged spatial_gls.predict_parameters. Mean,latent and independent-observation variances include fixed-effect uncertainty given supplied covariance.
operations.data: Query rows[d coordinates,p fixed features] in original units,exact width d+p
operations.args: Unchanged predict_parameters; never reads query outcomes or refits covariance
operations.estimator: x beta + c^T V^-1 residual; latent variance=sill-c^TV^-1c+delta^T(X^TV^-1X)^-1delta,delta=x-X^TV^-1c; observation variance adds independent query nugget
